title: Seismic Requirements.
officialText:
Smoke control systems covered by Section 909 are life safety systems and are required to function after an earthquake. Such smoke control systems shall be seismically designed in accordance with Section 1613 and ASCE 7-10. The component importance factor, I , shall be taken as 1.5 in accordance with ASCE 7-10, Section 13.1.3. p The smoke control system includes all components required for its operation, including but not limited to fans, ducts, electrical power, switchboards, motor control centers, starters, and controls.
Exception: Smoke control systems in structures classified in Seismic Design Categories A or B shall have a component importance factor, I , of 1.0. p
